1: Allah ne aasman ki qasam khai, aur us sitare ki qasam khai jo raat ko dastak deta hai.
2: Aey Rasool ﷺ, aap ko kya maloom ke yeh bara sitara kya hai?
3: Yeh woh sitara hai jo apni chamakti roshni se aasman ko chhed deta hai.
4: Koi jaan aisi nahin jis par Allah ne ek farishta muqarrar na kiya ho, jo qayamat ke hisaab ke liye us ke aamaal likhta hai.
5: Pas insan ko gaur karna chahiye ke Allah ne usey kis cheez se paida kiya, taake us par Allah ki qudrat aur apni bebasi wazeh ho jaye.
6: Allah ne usey ek uchhalte hue paani se paida kiya, jo rehm mein daala jata hai.
7: Yeh paani mard ki reerh ki haddi aur seene ki haddiyon ke darmiyan se nikalta hai.
8: Jis ne usey us haqeer paani se paida kiya, woh paak hai, aur usey yeh qudrat hai ke usey maut ke baad hisaab aur badle ke liye dobara zinda kar de.
9: Us din bhedon ko jaancha jayega aur jo niyatein aur aqeede dil chhupaye hue hain woh zahir kar diye jayenge, aur neik logon ko bure logon se alag kar diya jayega.
10: Us din insan ke paas na koi quwwat hogi ke woh apne aap ko Allah ke azaab se bachaye, aur na koi madadgar jo us ki madad kare.
11: Allah ne us aasman ki qasam khai jo baarish rakhta hai, kyunke woh us ki taraf se baar baar utarti hai.
12: Us ne us zameen ki qasam khai jo phat kar apne andar ke podey, phal aur darakht zahir karti hai.
13: Yeh Quran, jo Muhammad ﷺ par utara gaya, woh kalaam hai jo haqq ko batil se aur sach ko jhoot se alag kar deta hai.
14: Yeh koi khel aur batil baat nahin, balke yeh sanjida aur haqq hai.
15: Jo log us cheez ko jhutlate hain jo un ka Rasool un ke paas laya, woh us ki dawat ko radd karne aur jhutlane ke liye chaalein aur saazishein karte hain.
16: Aur main bhi tadbeer karta hoon ke deen ghalib ho aur batil batil sabit ho.
17: Pas aey Rasool ﷺ, in kafiron ko mohlat de dijiye. Unhein thore arse ki mohlat dein, aur un ke azaab aur halakat mein jaldi na chahein.
